critical_code_review_comments: RichTextEditor.web.tsx (271 lines) is fine in size; the onMouseDown.preventDefault() pattern on toolbar buttons is what preserves the caret and enables the 'first keystroke after Bold not lost' behaviour — do not remove it.

useRichEditor.useEffect sync compares editor.getHTML() vs toDoc(value); works correctly for the observed template-apply and edit-load flows. Consider guarding against value changing while user is typing (currently harmless because parent state mirrors onChange output).
QuoteBodyEditorModal.tsx wraps the editor Pressable in a ScrollView with stickyHeaderIndices=[1] — sticky toolbar works on desktop and stays reachable on 390px (wraps to 4-5 rows). Good.

quotation_service render pipeline correctly substitutes {client_name} at read/render time (body stays templated for reuse) and leaves unknown {{...}} tokens untouched — matches backend test expectations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Rich-text quotation body feature is stable. Key testIDs verified: [open-body-editor] on new-quotation form, [body-editor-modal] wrapper, [body-editor-close], [body-editor-done], [rich-toolbar] wrapper, [rt-bold]/[rt-italic]/[rt-underline]/[rt-strike], [rt-h1]/[rt-h2]/[rt-h3], [rt-left]/[rt-center]/[rt-right], [rt-bullet]/[rt-ordered]/[rt-quote]/[rt-hr], [rt-tbl] (insert) → becomes [rt-row+]/[rt-col+]/[rt-row-]/[rt-col-]/[rt-hdr]/[rt-tbl-] when caret inside a table, [rt-clear], [rt-fields] opens [rt-fields-menu] with [rt-field-<key>] chips (client_name, quotation_number, subject, total, ...). Editor itself is a plain DOM <div contenteditable='true' data-testid='quote-body-editor' class='tiptap ProseMirror pk-rich'> — use document.querySelector + el.focus() to seed the caret because Playwright's built-in click sometimes fails with 'outside of viewport' due to sticky-header layout. Toolbar buttons are real DOM <button data-testid='rt-*'> with onMouseDown.preventDefault so page.click(force=True) works reliably. HTML paste can be simulated with new ClipboardEvent('paste', {clipboardData: dt, bubbles:true, cancelable:true}) — TipTap accepts and normalises. Body-preview on the form and quotation-body on detail / public-quotation-body on /q/<token> all render sanitised HTML; {client_name} etc are substituted at render time (body field stays templated for template reuse).
